plugin.name: Target
plugin.author: Eric
plugin.purpose: Reports your room to a channel, plus the mob and its HP percent when fighting

muclient.script:
local VERSION = "1.2" local TAG = "Target"
local CLR_TAG = "#875FFF" -- x099 local CLR_NAME = "#00D7FF" -- x045 local CLR_MSG = "#FFFFFF" -- W local CLR_HI = "#00FF87" -- x048
local GMCP_ID = "3e7dedbe37e44942dd46d264"
-- channel word typed after "target" -> what it is, for the help screen local CHANNELS = { { key = "clan", label = "clan channel" }, { key = "ft", label = "ft channel" }, { key = "gt", label = "group channel" }, { key = "reply", label = "reply to your last tell" }, { key = "say", label = "say in the room" }, { key = "spo", label = "spouse channel" }, } table.sort (CHANNELS, function (a, b) return a.key < b.key end)
local function echo (msg) ColourNote (CLR_TAG, "", "[", CLR_NAME, "", TAG, CLR_TAG, "", "] ", CLR_MSG, "", msg) end
-- Read one GMCP section into a local table. nil if GMCP has nothing yet. local function gmcpRead (what) local ok, rc, s = pcall (CallPlugin, GMCP_ID, "gmcpdata_as_string", what) if not ok or rc ~= error_code.eOK or type (s) ~= "string" or s == "" then return nil end local f = loadstring ("return " .. s) if not f then return nil end local ok2, val = pcall (f) if ok2 then return val end return nil end
-- Aardwolf colour codes start with @; double any @ so names print literally. local function esc (s) return (tostring (s):gsub ("@", "@@")) end
local function buildMessage () local status = gmcpRead ("char.status") if type (status) ~= "table" then status = {} end local enemy = status.enemy and tostring (status.enemy) or "" local fighting = (tonumber (status.state) == 8 and enemy ~= "")
local room = gmcpRead ("room.info") if type (room) ~= "table" then if not fighting then return nil, "No GMCP room data yet. Try again in a moment." end room = {} end local zone = (room.zone and tostring (room.zone) ~= "") and tostring (room.zone) or "unknown" local name = (room.name and tostring (room.name) ~= "") and tostring (room.name) or "unknown" local num = tonumber (room.num) local vnum = (num and num > 0) and tostring (num) or "none"
local msg = "@x099[@x045Target Report@x099] " if fighting then local pct = tonumber (status.enemypct) local hp = pct and (pct .. "%") or "?" msg = msg .. "@WEnemy: @x099[@x048" .. esc (enemy) .. "@x099] " .. "@W| HP: @x099[@x048" .. hp .. "@x099] @W| " end return msg .. "@WArea: @x048" .. esc (zone) .. " " .. "@W| Room: @x048" .. esc (name) .. " " .. "@W| vnum: @x099[@x048" .. vnum .. "@x099]@w" end
function aliasReport (name, line, wildcards) local chan = wildcards.chan:lower () local msg, err = buildMessage () if not msg then echo (err) return end Send (chan .. " " .. msg) end
function aliasHelp () print ("") ColourNote (CLR_TAG, "", "[", CLR_NAME, "", TAG, CLR_TAG, "", "] ", CLR_MSG, "", "v" .. VERSION .. " help") ColourNote (CLR_MSG, "", " Reports your area, room and room number to a channel.") ColourNote (CLR_MSG, "", " While fighting, it adds the mob and its HP.") print ("") for _, c in ipairs (CHANNELS) do ColourNote (CLR_HI, "", string.format (" %-16s", "target " .. c.key), CLR_MSG, "", c.label) end ColourNote (CLR_HI, "", string.format (" %-16s", "target"), CLR_MSG, "", "this help") print ("") end
function OnPluginInstall () ColourNote (CLR_TAG, "", "[", CLR_NAME, "", TAG, CLR_TAG, "", "] ", CLR_MSG, "", "v" .. VERSION .. " loaded. Type ", CLR_HI, "", "target", CLR_MSG, "", " for help.") end
